name: Behemoth Grip
body:
Generating power from a low stance and four powerful arms, you can put more force behind your melee attacks than other creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): For every hand you grip a one-handed or two-handed weapon with after the 2nd, you gain an additional 0.5x your Strength modifier for each hand.
